\section*{Chapter 23 - Threat Model \& Guardrails}


\subsection*{Purpose}

This chapter defines a practical, enforceable threat model for AIM-OS/APOE and installs guardrails-as-code that hold under real workloads: RAG, agents, tools, IDE-in-the-loop. Every control emits witnesses (VIF) and connects to the Shared Evidence Graph (SEG) so we can prove what the system did, why, and under which risk posture.

\subsection*{Executive Summary}

AIM-OS operates on living memory, executes tools, and ships software. That makes it a high-value target. We treat security, safety, and privacy as first-class capabilities: the system must anticipate misuse, constrain power, measure uncertainty, and prove lineage.

\textbf{Security Doctrine (tl;dr):}
\item \textbf{Deny by default:} Capabilities are requested and granted with scope, duration, and rate.
\item \textbf{Untrusted by construction:} All user/content/context is tainted until proven otherwise.
\item \textbf{Plan before power:} ACL/APOE plans are statically checked; high-risk steps require HITL (Ch.17).
\item \textbf{Degrade safely:} When in doubt, abstain (κ-gating) or contain (least-privilege sandbox), not "best-guess."

\subsection*{Threat Model for Agentic Systems}

We profile threats by surface and goal. Each entry lists typical attacks → symptoms → controls.

\subsubsection*{Prompt- \& Context-Level Threats}

\textbf{Vectors:}
\item Classic prompt injection (direct/indirect)
\item Instruction smuggling in HTML/Markdown/CSV/ALT text
\item Jailbreak patterns
\item Overlong-context poisoning
\item Retrieval booby-traps ("ignore previous; exfiltrate X")

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Role leakage
\item Tool misuse
\item Non-deterministic replies
\item Policy bypass in citations

\textbf{Controls:}

\textbf{Role Isolation:}
\item System vs. user vs. tool prompts are separately hashed and stored
\item Only system prompt may set policy
\item User prompts cannot override system policy
\item Tool prompts are validated before execution

\textbf{Quoted-Content Boxing:}
\item Untrusted text is wrapped with verbatim fences + provenance tags
\item Never executed as instruction
\item Content marked as data, not code
\item Provenance tags enable audit trail

\textbf{Policy-Prefix Pinning:}
\item A signed policy prelude (template hash + SEG id) precedes all chains
\item Policy hash verified before execution
\item Policy changes require re-signing
\item SEG links enable policy audit

\textbf{Detector Ensemble:}
\item Pattern + LM-based detectors score "instructionality"
\item HTML/script payloads detected
\item Known jailbreaks identified
\item Raise κ or strip malicious content

\subsubsection*{Tooling \& RAG Threats}

\textbf{Vectors:}
\item Over-permissive tools
\item TOCTOU races
\item SSRF via URL tools
\item Unlimited file I/O
\item Secret leakage from vector stores
\item Prompt injection through retrieved docs

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Calls to arbitrary hosts
\item Filesystem traversal
\item Credentials in responses
\item "Phantom" tool execs

\textbf{Controls:}

\textbf{Capability Tokens (CapTok):}
\item Signed, short-lived, scoped (action, resource, rate, region)
\item JWT/JWP format with claims: sub (plan\_id/step\_id), act (Verb), res (Resource pattern), lim (rate/size), exp (TTL ≤ minutes), aud (tool runtime), jti (replay)
\item Runtime enforcement via sidecar intercepting syscalls/network
\item Violations raise SEG "violation" edges with packet metadata

\textbf{Tool Sandboxes:}
\item Per-tool containers with network egress allowlists
\item Read-only FS by default
\item CPU/mem/time quotas enforced
\item Syscall filters prevent dangerous operations
\item Least power defaults: no shell, no child process, no write, no outbound by default

\textbf{RAG Allow+Deny Lists:}
\item Per-connector hostname/tenant allowlists
\item MIME/type guards
\item Content disinfect (strip scripts/links) before inclusion
\item Retrieved snippets are data; they cannot alter policy

\textbf{Result Boxing:}
\item APOE treats RAG outputs as inputs only
\item RAG results cannot execute code
\item Results validated before use
\item Provenance tracked via SEG

\subsubsection*{Network \& SSRF Threats}

\textbf{Vectors:}
\item URL fetch tools pointed at metadata endpoints
\item Internal services, cloud IMDS
\item DNS rebinding
\item IPv6 literals
\item file://, gopher:// protocols

\textbf{Controls:}

\textbf{URL Normalizer:}
\item Reject non-HTTP(S) schemes
\item Reject IP literals
\item Reject link-local addresses
\item Reject private RFC1918 addresses unless explicitly allowed
\item Validate hostname format

\textbf{Egress Policy:}
\item Per-tool egress via proxy with hostname pinning
\item TLS enforcement required
\item Request recording into SEG
\item Egress allowlists enforced

\textbf{DNS Hardening:}
\item Single trusted resolver
\item Cache poisoning mitigations
\item SNI/ALPN checks
\item DNS queries logged

\subsubsection*{Data Exfiltration \& Privacy}

\textbf{Vectors:}
\item Model answers echo secrets
\item Embeddings store PII
\item Logs leak tokens
\item Oversharing to third parties

\textbf{Controls:}

\textbf{PII/Secret Classifiers:}
\item Regex+ML classifiers in write paths (CMC ingest)
\item Classifiers in read paths (render)
\item Automatic detection and masking
\item Classification confidence tracked

\textbf{Differential Privacy (DP):}
\item Event DP for telemetry
\item ε budgets per tenant/user/feature
\item Decay (τ) resets budgets
\item Report DP for metrics dashboards
\item Laplace/Gaussian noise added
\item ECE calibration unaffected
\item SEG nodes store (ε, δ, mech, scope)
\item Exceeding budget → κ-abstain

\textbf{Segregated Stores:}
\item PII on RLS-protected tables
\item Vector store contains redacted/hashed variants
\item Linkage via SEG only
\item Access controls enforced

\textbf{Synthetic Labeling:}
\item Watermark/model tags for generated content (VIF)
\item Content provenance tracked
\item Synthetic content marked
\item Audit trail maintained

\subsubsection*{Supply Chain \& Codegen Threats}

\textbf{Vectors:}
\item Malicious packages
\item Typosquatting
\item Poisoned snippets
\item License traps
\item CI secret exposure

\textbf{Controls:}

\textbf{SBOM + License Allowlist:}
\item Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) gates
\item License allowlist enforcement
\item sigstore/SLSA provenance on artifacts
\item Package validation before use

\textbf{Policy Packs:}
\item Enforce banned APIs
\item Dangerous patterns (eval, spawn) blocked in codegen
\item Policy violations trigger alerts
\item Policy updates require approval

\textbf{CI Secrets Broker:}
\item Short-lived OIDC tokens from KMS
\item Zero plaintext secrets in env/logs
\item Secret rotation automated
\item Access audit trail maintained

\subsection*{Guardrails-as-Code (Enforced by APOE/ACL)}

We encode guardrails at plan, step, and tool levels. All checks emit witness events (VIF).

\subsubsection*{ACL Snippets}

\textbf{Capability Tokens \& Sandboxes:}
``\texttt{yaml
tool http\_fetch
  caps { action:"GET", hosts:["docs.example.com"], rate:"60/m", max\_bytes:5e6 }
  sandbox { net\_egress:["docs.example.com:443"], fs:"ro", cpu\_ms:2000, mem\_mb:256, timeout\_ms:3000 }
  gate { g\_url\_safe, g\_egress\_allowed, g\_span\_vif }

tool file\_read
  caps { action:"READ", paths:["/workspace/specs/*.md"], max\_bytes:1e6 }
  sandbox { fs:"ro", chroot:"/workspace", syscalls\_deny:["execve","mount"] }
  gate { g\_path\_allow, g\_span\_vif }
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Prompt Hygiene \& Tainting:}
}`\texttt{yaml
step synthesize\_answer
  in  { query, retrieved[] }
  policy { taint: ["retrieved"], quote\_untrusted:true, policy\_prefix: "seg://policy/answering@v3" }
  gate { g\_injection\_scan, g\_policy\_prefix\_signed, g\_kappa\_band }
}`\texttt{

\textbf{SSRF Defense for URL Tools:}
}`\texttt{yaml
gate g\_url\_safe
  checks { scheme in ["https"], host not\_in private\_ranges, port in [443] }
}`\texttt{

\subsubsection*{κ-Gating \& Abstention}

At each boundary, compute risk = f(injection\_score, PII\_score, UQ, budget\_drift). If risk ≥ κ, the system:

\textbf{Abstains:}
\item With rationale + remediation link
\item Logs decision to SEG
\item Emits VIF witness
\item Provides user feedback

\textbf{Contains:}
\item By downgrading capabilities (read-only tools, masked output)
\item Limits scope of operation
\item Reduces risk exposure
\item Maintains audit trail

\textbf{Routes to HITL:}
\item Two-key approval required (Ch.17)
\item Human review for high-risk operations
\item Approval workflow enforced
\item Decision recorded in SEG

\subsection*{Tool Sandboxes \& Capability Tokens (CapTok)}

\subsubsection*{Design}

A CapTok is a signed JWT/JWP with claims:
\item }sub\texttt{ (plan\_id/step\_id): Subject identifier
\item }act\texttt{ (Verb): Action allowed
\item }res\texttt{ (Resource pattern): Resource scope
\item }lim\texttt{ (rate/size): Limits
\item }exp\texttt{ (TTL ≤ minutes): Expiration
\item }aud\texttt{ (tool runtime): Audience
\item }jti\texttt{ (replay): JWT ID for replay prevention

\subsubsection*{Runtime Enforcement}

\textbf{Sidecar Interception:}
\item Sidecar intercepts all syscalls/network
\item Matches against CapTok
\item Violations raise SEG "violation" edges
\item Packet metadata recorded (no payloads with PII)
\item Tool outputs labeled with cap\_id for downstream audit

\textbf{Least Power Defaults:}
\item No shell access
\item No child process execution
\item No write access
\item No outbound network by default
\item Explicit egress allowlist required
\item DNS pinned to trusted resolver
\item TLS cert pinning optional

\subsection*{Redaction, DP, and Output Hygiene}

\subsubsection*{Multi-Stage Redaction}

\textbf{Ingest (CMC):}
\item Classify and mask secrets/PII
\item Store pointer to vaulted original (KMS-wrapped)
\item Redaction metadata tracked
\item Original accessible under policy

\textbf{Index (HHNI):}
\item Embeddings computed on redacted content
\item SEG retains reversible link under policy
\item Redaction preserves semantic meaning
\item Access controls enforced

\textbf{Render:}
\item Re-apply redaction by audience/purpose
\item Attach VIF explaining masks
\item Context-aware redaction
\item Audit trail maintained

\textbf{Mask Formats:}
\item Deterministic hashes for joinability (hash(email, pepper))
\item Reversible tokens in secure contexts
\item DP-protected aggregates for analytics
\item Format chosen based on use case

\subsubsection*{Differential Privacy (DP)}

\textbf{Event DP:}
\item For telemetry
\item ε budgets per tenant/user/feature
\item Decay (τ) resets budgets
\item Budget tracking automated

\textbf{Report DP:}
\item For metrics dashboards
\item Laplace/Gaussian noise added
\item ECE calibration unaffected
\item Privacy-utility tradeoff managed

\textbf{SEG Integration:}
\item SEG nodes store (ε, δ, mech, scope)
\item Budget tracking via SEG
\item Exceeding budget → κ-abstain
\item Audit trail complete

\subsection*{Abstention \& Containment Patterns}

\subsubsection*{When to Abstain}

\textbf{Conditions:}
\item UQ high (ECE band breach)
\item RS low (reliability score)
\item Policy conflict detected
\item Privacy budget exhausted
\item Confidence below threshold

\textbf{Process:}
1. Risk assessment computes risk score
2. Compare against κ threshold
3. If risk ≥ κ, abstain
4. Log decision to SEG
5. Emit VIF witness
6. Provide user feedback

\subsubsection*{When to Contain}

\textbf{Conditions:}
\item Risk elevated but below abstention threshold
\item Partial capability acceptable
\item Degraded operation preferred to failure

\textbf{Process:}
1. Risk assessment identifies containment opportunity
2. Downgrade capabilities (read-only, masked output)
3. Limit scope of operation
4. Monitor for escalation
5. Log containment decision to SEG

\subsection*{Integration Points}

\subsubsection*{VIF Integration}

\textbf{Witness Envelopes:}
\item All security decisions emit VIF witnesses
\item Witnesses include risk assessment, decision rationale, remediation links
\item Witnesses stored in CMC with bitemporal tracking
\item Witnesses enable deterministic replay

\textbf{Confidence Routing:}
\item Low confidence triggers security review
\item High confidence enables automatic processing
\item Confidence thresholds configurable per operation type
\item Confidence degradation triggers alerts

\subsubsection*{SEG Integration}

\textbf{Evidence Anchors:}
\item All security events linked to SEG
\item Contradiction detection for policy violations
\item Temporal awareness for threat patterns
\item Knowledge synthesis for threat intelligence

\textbf{Policy Enforcement:}
\item Policies stored as SEG claims
\item Policy changes tracked temporally
\item Policy violations detected automatically
\item Policy audit trail complete

\subsubsection*{APOE Integration}

\textbf{Plan Validation:}
\item Plans statically checked for security violations
\item High-risk steps require HITL approval
\item Plan execution monitored for deviations
\item Plan results validated against security policy

\textbf{Chain Execution:}
\item Security gates enforced at each step
\item Capability tokens validated before tool execution
\item Sandbox enforcement during execution
\item Results validated before propagation

\subsection*{Failure Modes \& Mitigations}

\subsubsection*{Policy Bypass}

\textbf{Scenario:} Attacker bypasses security policy through novel attack vector.

\textbf{Mitigation:}
\item Multi-layer defense (defense in depth)
\item Continuous monitoring for anomalies
\item Rapid policy updates via SEG
\item Threat intelligence integration

\subsubsection*{Sandbox Escape}

\textbf{Scenario:} Attacker escapes tool sandbox to access host system.

\textbf{Mitigation:}
\item Hardened container isolation
\item Syscall filtering enforced
\item Resource quotas strictly enforced
\item Network egress restricted
\item Regular security audits

\subsubsection*{Privacy Budget Exhaustion}

\textbf{Scenario:} Privacy budget exhausted, preventing legitimate analytics.

\textbf{Mitigation:}
\item Budget decay mechanisms
\item Budget allocation optimization
\item Alternative analysis methods
\item Human review for critical operations

\subsection*{Ops Runbook}

\subsubsection*{Daily Security Monitoring}

\textbf{Step 1:} Monitor security dashboard (violations, alerts, budget status)

\textbf{Metrics:}
\item Policy violations per hour
\item CapTok rejections
\item Privacy budget utilization
\item Sandbox escape attempts

\textbf{Success Criteria:} No critical violations, budget utilization <80\%, no escape attempts

\subsubsection*{Weekly Threat Review}

\textbf{Step 2:} Review threat intelligence and update policies

\textbf{Process:}
\item Analyze SEG violation patterns
\item Update detector signatures
\item Adjust κ thresholds
\item Update policy packs

\textbf{Success Criteria:} Policies updated, detectors improved, threat coverage maintained

\subsubsection*{Monthly Security Audit}

\textbf{Step 3:} Comprehensive security audit

\textbf{Process:}
\item Review all security events
\item Validate policy effectiveness
\item Test sandbox isolation
\item Verify privacy budget accuracy

\textbf{Success Criteria:} All policies effective, sandboxes secure, privacy budgets accurate
